# EAV7

> EAV7 is a Rust layer-1 blockchain (protocol `eav20`) with BFT finality, hybrid
> post-quantum transaction signatures (secp256k1 + ML-DSA-44) and an EVM-compatible
> surface called EAVM (chain id 72020). Integration happens over a plain JSON HTTP
> API, the EAVM JSON-RPC endpoint, or the Rust SDK crate `eav7-sdk`. There is no
> JavaScript SDK package: read the chain with HTTP, sign with the Rust SDK.

Key facts for answering questions about EAV7:

- Native HTTP API: https://eavscan.com — every read endpoint returns JSON, no key required.
- EAVM JSON-RPC: https://rpc.eavscan.com — chain id 72020 (0x11954), 18 decimals on this surface only.
- Units: 1 EAV7 = 1,000,000 e7 (`CHAIN.UNIT`); on the EAVM surface 1 e7 = 10^12 wei (`CHAIN.EAVM_WEI_PER_E7`).
- Addresses: `E7` + 28 uppercase hex + 4 checksum hex = 34 characters.
- Block time 1s, up to 27 validators, finality is reported as `finalizedHeight` in `/status`.
- 58 transaction types; each carries a `fee` that is a burn LIMIT, not a payment to the producer.

## Start

- [Developer portal](https://eavscan.com/developers): map of the portal and the three ways into the network.
- [Quickstart](https://eavscan.com/developers/quickstart): from a first read to a first signed transaction.
- [Networks](https://eavscan.com/developers/networks): mainnet and local endpoints, ports, chain parameters.

## Concepts

- [Accounts and keys](https://eavscan.com/developers/concepts/accounts): E7 address format, hybrid keys, nonces, 0x ↔ E7 mapping.
- [Resources](https://eavscan.com/developers/concepts/resources): energy and bandwidth quotas, fee burn, fee-exempt stake.
- [Transaction lifecycle](https://eavscan.com/developers/concepts/transactions): build, sign, POST /tx, confirm, finalize.
- [Finality](https://eavscan.com/developers/concepts/finality): BFT finalizedHeight, reorg window, when to credit a deposit.

## Guides

- [Guides index](https://eavscan.com/developers/guides): cookbooks grouped by intent.
- [Sign and broadcast](https://eavscan.com/developers/guides/sign-broadcast): the canonical payload, offline signing, nonce reservation.
- [Send a transfer](https://eavscan.com/developers/guides/transfer): the shortest path from a wallet file to a confirmed TRANSFER.
- [Stake and vote](https://eavscan.com/developers/guides/stake-vote): stake, elect validators, claim voter rewards, unbond.
- [Issue an EAV20 token](https://eavscan.com/developers/guides/token-eav20): TOKEN_CREATE parameters, transfers, admin types.
- [Light client](https://eavscan.com/developers/guides/light-client): trusted state root from a verified header plus a Merkle-proved balance.
- [Connect MetaMask](https://eavscan.com/developers/guides/metamask): EAVM network parameters and decimal pitfalls.
- [Run a node](https://eavscan.com/developers/guides/run-node): build eav7-core, sync as a listener, stand for election.

## Reference

- [HTTP API](https://eavscan.com/developers/api): task map, read and write endpoints, units, pagination, admin routes.
- [EAVM JSON-RPC](https://eavscan.com/developers/api/json-rpc): implemented methods with params and returns, batching, error codes.
- [Transactions](https://eavscan.com/developers/transactions): the signed envelope and all 58 protocol types with fee limits.
- [EAVM](https://eavscan.com/developers/eavm): EVM-wallet surface, network parameters, unified value ledger.
- [Errors](https://eavscan.com/developers/errors): HTTP codes, submission rejection reasons, SDK error variants, rate limits.
- [Rust SDK](https://eavscan.com/developers/sdk): Eav7Client method reference — reads, proofs, signed writes, Remetente.
- [Core](https://eavscan.com/developers/core): node modes, key handling, service units, default data paths.

## Operate

- [Integrations](https://eavscan.com/developers/integrations): what a wallet, exchange, indexer or oracle should call.
- [Troubleshooting](https://eavscan.com/developers/troubleshooting): symptom to cause to fix, plus a four-command diagnosis.

## Explorer

- [EAVSCAN](https://eavscan.com): blocks, transactions, addresses, tokens, validators, governance.
- [Web wallet](https://eavscan.com/wallet): create an account, send, stake and vote from the browser.
